bootstrap.pairing: Same resampled cluster multiplicities in every cell/endpoint; retain all source draws and native occurrences inside each source.
bootstrap.source_resampling: Resample24 source clusters with replacement, sample size24; use per-source planned-draw means.
bootstrap.QA_resampling: Resample entire A5 question blocks with replacement, same number of blocks; concatenate all question copies and compute sum(score)/question count, not mean(block means).
bootstrap.CI: Two-sided95% percentile CI of point difference, quantiles0.025/0.975, method=linear; marginal, not simultaneous. Separately [q0.025(Delta_L*),q0.975(Delta_U*)] as identification sensitivity.
bootstrap.primary_estimand: H1/H2 symmetric conservative point-score differences; H4 F1 on all fixed observed pairs. First mean planned draws/source, then24-source mean. No lower-bound difference as primary.
bootstrap.null_centering: T_b0=delta0+(Delta_b_star-Delta_hat); p=(1+count(T_b0>=Delta_hat))/10001; delta0=0 forH1/H4,-0.05 forH2. Same cluster multiplicities in paired cells.
bootstrap.unusable: Undefined planned denominator, fewer than2 independent blocks, invalid bootstrap outputs or zero resampled-statistic variation: raw_p=null, reason, no inferential pass. Two blocks are necessary, not evidence of adequate precision/power.
bootstrap.limitations: Approximate bootstrap, especially with few/unequal clusters. Finite tested populations/models, no universal transfer.

Wilcoxon.role: prespecified sensitivity, never choose more favorable p
Wilcoxon.unit: one planned-draw mean per source, across sources; not a separate tiny test per source
Wilcoxon.shift: d_s forH1; d_s+0.05 forH2. H3 no prespecified inferential test.
Wilcoxon.ties: Round differences to12 decimals for ranks only; keep unrounded estimation
Wilcoxon.method: Fixed sign-permutation signed-rank calculation,10000 draws, seed2026102408; all-zero differences p=1; D1 pins software.
Wilcoxon.missing: Use same primary symmetric scores when denominators defined. Undefined source pair cannot be silently removed from full24 test; any complete-subset sensitivity explicitly labeled.
Wilcoxon.assumption: Symmetric paired-difference distribution for a location interpretation; not generally the mean estimand.

Holm.not_tested: raw_p=null with reason, not rejection;1 only as conservative multiplicity slot, never as observed score. Family remains3.
Holm.no_selection: No extra primary family by model/type/cohort/cell; H3,EM,ablations,distinct count secondary.
Holm.CI_warning: 95% CIs marginal, not Holm-adjusted simultaneous intervals.

analysis.decision: H1 requires positive point difference and Holm rejection; H2 Holm rejection at-0.05, not nonsignificance at0. H4 F1 inferential improvement requires positive point difference and Holm rejection; descriptive nondecrease alone is not equivalent performance proof. No overall/universal winner or schema superiority from selected axes.

H1.title: Higher share of source-supported whole statements
H1.numerator: S_csd: all independently source-supported whole native occurrences retained in cell c/source s/draw d
H1.denominator: N_csd: all emitted/retained whole EE/EV/VV occurrences in the cell, including unclear/unjudged ones; no string/value deduplication
H1.point_when_identified: S_csd/N_csd for every known N>0. Unclear and technically missing JUDGMENTS contribute0 to S in both arms, remain in N.
H1.bounds: [S/N,(S+M)/N] when N is known and positive, with N=S+F+M
H1.primary_test: one-sided null-centered paired source-cluster bootstrap of symmetric conservative point-score difference
H1.estimand: share of emitted whole occurrences independently verified supported under this evaluator protocol; not the unknown true error rate
H1.missingness_rate: M_csd/N_csd and pooled M/N by arm plus source-equal rate; any arm>0.10 explicitly a limitation
H1.sensitivity: Identification interval [S/N,(S+M)/N]; Delta_L=L_V2-U_AS and Delta_U=U_V2-L_AS are sensitivity bounds only, never primary statistic/p-value.

H2.title: Full reference-meaning retention non-inferior by5 percentage points
H2.population: same24 sources, source-only reference roster frozen before outcomes
H2.numerator: K_csd: all predeclared reference meanings fully covered anywhere in that retained inventory
H2.denominator: R_s: every predeclared valid whole source-only reference meaning for the source, same across cells/draws
H2.point_when_identified: K_csd/R_s. Unclear and technically missing judgments contribute0 to K in both arms; all frozen R_s remain in denominator.
H2.partial_rule: 0 denotes not fully retained, not wholly false/lost. Report partial separately.
H2.witness_rule: Direct independent judgments for all four active inventory cells AS/AS_G/V1/V2; active_cell(...) is the sole inventory input. No private restore state or deleted parent assertions. No general offline inheritance from A8.
H2.primary_test: one-sided null-centered paired source-cluster bootstrap of symmetric conservative point-score difference at-0.05
H2.coding_limit: These0 values score not verified fully retained, not known false or completely lost. Raw states preserved separately.
H2.missingness_rate: Unclear+technical_missing over all frozen R_s, by arm; any arm>0.10 explicitly a limitation
H2.sensitivity: [K/R,(K+M)/R], paired Delta_L/Delta_U only sensitivity; fixed references cannot be replaced after outcomes.

H3.title: Technical direct graph-edge coverage under A6 operational obligations
H3.numerator: C_csd: retained native occurrences satisfying the frozen A6 operational graph-edge obligation test
H3.denominator: N_csd: every whole native EE/EV/VV occurrence retained before export in the same cell
H3.EE_VV: Correct endpoint identity, direction and relation label via original IDs/CSV mapping. Preserve multiplicity; one graph-edge occurrence cannot cover multiple collapsed native edge obligations.
H3.EV: A6 complete operational participant-edge group; not proof of whole native EV payload/qualifier/role semantics. whole_native_EV_payload_recovery_verified=False.
H3.bounds: [C/N,(C+M)/N] for positive known N. Confirmed completed-graph absence is observed0; unexamined/unavailable graph or unresolved identity mapping is unknown.
diagnostics: coverage against original unfiltered parent denominator
H3.claim_limit: Technical graph representation only; no H3 confirmatory superiority test, no semantic equivalence or full native-EV recovery claim.

H4.title: MuSiQue graph-only answer F1 primary, EM secondary
H4.population: All60 fixed A5prefix questions, identical across cells
H4.denominator: Q=60: every fixed A5prefix question ID, identical across cells
H4.reader_context: Only retrieved final-graph triple text, top_k=30; no source passages, support flags, gold paragraphs/answers/aliases in index or reader context.
H4.scorer: Official MuSiQue AnswerMetric normalization/token F1/max over aliases. Preserve unrounded per-question values for inference, not only rounded official aggregate.
H4.bounds: For observed z use[z,z], otherwise[0,1]; aggregate over all Q; never convert missing to empty string or0.
H4.scientific_target: Delta_F1>=0 descriptively; inferential one-sided test at0 concerns improvement, not equivalence or noninferiority from nonsignificance.
H4.inferential_proposal: one-sided null-centered paired question-cluster bootstrap of F1 differences at0, sole H4 Holm input

McNemar.role: EM-only secondary sensitivity; not H4 Holm input; pairwise-complete question count reported
McNemar.table: W=AS wrong/V2 correct, L=AS correct/V2 wrong; other cells both wrong/both correct
McNemar.population: fully observed paired EM outcomes, subset size reported
McNemar.assumption: Binomial exactness requires independent pairs. With paragraph/family overlap it is only an independence-working-model sensitivity, not an unqualified exact test. No p-bound follows from missing-score bounds.

H4.QA_export_scope: All eight fixed graph cells; primary V2_ROW vs AS_ORIGINAL, other contrasts secondary. One instance construction per AS/V1. Secondary contexts subject to the same5USD cap; never weaken primary set after results.
secondary_contexts: direct gold-paragraph control once per question
H4.secondary_claim: Passage/source controls are not graph-only H4 evidence; graph-only scores alone do not prove faithful graph use.
H4.pipeline_scope: B4 instance-only matched AS/V1 derived views. No schema-induction or complete-schema-KG quality claim.
H4.missing_rule: For H4 retain missing as unknown, not empty or wrong. Primary point/p-value require all planned paired scores. Otherwise non-estimable primary, Holm slot1, report full-Q score bounds and completed-pair descriptive sensitivity.

missingness.paired_bounds: Delta_L=L_V2-U_AS; Delta_U=U_V2-L_AS. Average all planned draws, then equally all sources; forQA average all fixed questions.
missingness.zero_or_unknown_denominator: H1/H3 undefined, never0 or1/100%. Do not silently omit planned source/draw. Its full24-source primary mean cannot be tested: raw_p=null, Holm slot1. Report emptiness/completion separately.
missingness.whole_missing_construction: Never invent native denominator forH1/H3. ForH2 fixedR_s remains: rawunknown, numerical primary0 for not verified fully retained in both arms. ForH4 fixedQ remains with unknown scores/bounds, not fabricated0.
missingness.known_empty_answer: Only a genuinely completed observed empty/abstaining answer may receive its official metric value; never replace missing/truncated/unparsed response by empty string.
missingness.subset_inheritance: C2 source-support labels may inherit exact occurrence identity into filtered subsets. H2 requires separate direct active-inventory assessment for all four arms.
missingness.loss_scope: Correct parts of unsupported whole assertions may be lost. Report supported-whole removals, selected partial losses and unassessed scope. Selected-reference retention is not exhaustive recall.
missingness.primary_H1_H2: Numerical0 for unclear/technical judgment missingness in both arms, per direct G2 amendment. Preserve raw unknown; not a fact-level false label.

human_validation.population: Original C2 AS/V1 whole occurrences on24 confirmation sources, not Main12
human_validation.sampling: Without replacement before reading labels. Redistribute shortfalls one-by-one in fixed AS-EE,AS-EV,AS-VV,V1-EE,V1-EV,V1-VV order among strata with capacity. If total<150 use all, report shortage, never duplicate. Selected human panel remains150 total; it cannot imply every semantic merge is validated unless its separate recorded validation covers them.

kappa.kind: unweighted nominal Cohen kappa human versus C2
kappa.N_pair: both assessments present; unclear valid class, technical/missing not unclear

second_evaluator.population: Original unique C2 AS/V1 occurrences, stratified arm×EE/EV/VV; seed2026102410 before labels. Add every Guard-removed occurrence of either parent arm for every source represented in the random sample. Union by occurrence ID, no duplicate calls.
second_evaluator.analysis: Report random15% portion separately from augmented removals; augmented panel is not prevalence-representative. Same fixed blind ordering and6-case grouping; secondary comparisons only.
